title: The Last Wrangler
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Montana, 1912. The railroads have won, but veteran wrangler Cole Hayden takes one last herd of longhorns over the Beartooth Pass for an old rancher who refuses to sell — and finds his estranged son riding in a rival outfit.
short_description: Cole Hayden, 58, takes one last drive over the Beartooth Pass; the crew includes a young vaquero, a Black cowboy, a drunk cook — and his estranged son Will rides for the rival Wainwrights.
long_description: Cole Hayden, 58, takes one last drive over the Beartooth Pass; the crew includes a young vaquero, a Black cowboy, a drunk cook — and his estranged son Will rides for the rival Wainwrights. Blizzard, stampede, rustlers, and a railhead showdown force father and son to choose sides.
main_characters: Will Hayden — Cole's son, proud, angry
